verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents an undetected or stealth browser mode for evading bot detection. The closest items are adjacent: `premium_proxy` is a proxy-routing option "to bypass difficult to scrape websites", and `stealth_proxy` appears only in a note that `infinite_scroll` is not supported with it, with no description of browser-level detection evasion. Proxy rotation and standard headless browser rendering are related controls, not the named undetected-browser capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use an undetected browser mode to bypass sophisticated bot detection systems
